sub_site: CSF of children with hydrocephalus at initial surgery

evidence.quote: CSF was obtained at initial surgical intervention.
DNA was extracted from CSF samples and amplified with the REPLI-g Mini Kit (Qiagen, CN: 150023). A random-fragment library was prepared and sequenced on the HiSeq 2500 Illumina platform.
Taxonomic assignments, extraction control samples, and qPCR DNA concentrations were used.
To assess the potential impact of contaminants on WGAS results, we used the computational package decontam R [ 22 ].
The total bacterial loads for all 66 CSF samples were quantified using broad-range 16S rRNA gene quantitative PCR (qPCR)

notes: 66 CSF samples; 16S qPCR on all, culture in STGG/standard; WGAS (whole-genome amplification + shotgun, Kraken2) only on 11 STGG-positive + 1 standard-culture-positive sample. Only the most abundant WGAS organism per sample reported (Table 2). Culture-only genera (Cutibacterium, Lactobacillus, Neisseria, Streptococcus, Dermacoccus, Niallia, Paenibacillus) not recorded as they are not sequencing results. Authors: cannot rule out bacteria but may be contaminants. Multi-centre (includes Canadian sites); country left blank.
